data.summary: Fixed the privacy leak in the Profit KPI. I added formatPercentForPrivacy to currencyAdapter.js, and Summary.jsx now uses it, so the total and organic rows both show "******" in privacy mode. The Gain/Loss/Break-even badge is now hidden in privacy mode too, because it would leak the sign. I added a unit test for the helper. I could not run anything in this environment, so the tests and build have not been run.

changedFiles.purpose: Mask the Profit value and hide the sign badge in privacy mode

testsAdded.description: Covers formatPercentForPrivacy: masked when private, and positive, negative and zero ratios when not private

appliedFeedback: Profit KPI now uses formatPercentForPrivacy(profit, isPrivate) in Summary.jsx, covering both the total and organic rows.
Added formatPercentForPrivacy next to formatValueForPrivacy in currencyAdapter.js, with the same '******' mask, and imported it in Summary.jsx.
Added currencyAdapter.test.js with private and non-private cases, using explicit imports and var inside function bodies. It has no helpers, so none need to go at the end of the file.
The badge is not rendered when isPrivate is true. signClass is unchanged on the value.
No chart or service files were touched.

selfVerification.notes: I had no command execution, so npm test and npm run build were not run. The helper and its tests are simple and I checked them by reading.
